deviations.what: T030, T031 and T032 landed as test-only commits with zero production code change.
deviations.why: Each task's acceptance criterion is already satisfied by existing framework or prior-story code: T030 by fairdm's PrivateRecordNotFoundMixin/DatasetManager (private-by-default visibility, which T029's un-implementable-but-also-unneeded assessor branch already relies on), T031 by Review.current and SubmittedFile's per-submission rows (US-1/US-3), T032 by project/ghfdb/constants.py's ACCEPTED_UNSTORED_COLUMNS (FR-009, US-4) plus ReviewConfirmView never touching Review.reviewers. Each was probed per craft-tdd rather than accepted on inspection: a one-line mutation of the exact mechanism each test protects was applied, the new test observed to fail for the right reason, then reverted before the real commit.

deviations.what: T029's curator branch (setting Dataset.visibility and Dataset.published together on a curator's confirmation) was not implemented; no code was written for it.
deviations.why: Dataset.published does not exist on the fairdm dependency version this repository is pinned to (poetry.lock resolved_reference 8c9290f4b01365688117be69a5c1885d1815a3b1), confirmed via Dataset._meta.get_fields() against the running model class rather than inferred from data-model.md/research.md. The field exists on fairdm's main branch (fetched directly from GitHub, 2026-09-16), added after this pin was resolved -- a dependency-version gap. Setting only visibility=PUBLIC was considered and rejected: it would look fully correct today (every current enforcement point checks visibility alone) but would silently regress into the exact half-published state data-model.md warns against the next time the fairdm pin is bumped and published starts defaulting False. Bumping the pin unilaterally was also rejected -- a dependency-version decision outside an Implementer's authority, and poetry.lock regeneration against a moving HEAD can pull in unrelated upstream changes.
